name: RS-instructions
description: A comprehensive benchmark dataset integrating four diverse single-task datasets related to captioning and visual question answering (VQA) in remote sensing imagery, designed to evaluate multi-task vision-language models adapted for remote sensing image analysis.
reputation: A recent remote-sensing multimodal benchmark with some relevance to the community, but it is still relatively new and not yet a canonical standard.
notes: Integrates four single-task datasets for captioning and VQA in remote sensing; focuses on multi-task model evaluation.
